name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Push the hips back, lowering the dumbbells along your legs.
Descend until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back flat.
Drive the hips forward to stand. The dumbbells allow a natural path.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: A beginner dumbbell hinge-pattern exercise for the hamstrings. Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell) builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
